description: This script generates markdown documentation from C header files (.h) by parsing header structures, combining multiple headers if needed, and producing formatted markdown files. It includes functions for parsing headers, combining structures, and writing markdown sections, as well as command-line interface for processing header files individually or combined.

classes.name: HeaderFileParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing header files and extracting header structures.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Class for logging messages and errors during processing.

methods.name: combine_header_structures
methods.description: Merges additional header structure data into the main structure.

methods.name: get_header_files
methods.description: Retrieves all .h files from a specified folder.

methods.name: create_logger
methods.description: Creates a logger instance for a given class name and optional log file path.

methods.name: find_main_header_file
methods.description: Selects the main header file, preferring plugin_name.h if available.

methods.name: parse_header_file
methods.description: Parses a header file and returns its structure.

methods.name: write_markdown_sections
methods.description: Writes markdown sections for methods, properties, and events to a file.

methods.name: generate_md_from_individual_header_file
methods.description: Generates a markdown file from a header structure.

methods.name: process_individual_headers
methods.description: Processes each header file separately to generate markdown documentation.

methods.name: process_combined_headers
methods.description: Processes all header files combined into a single markdown documentation.

methods.name: generate_md_from_header
methods.description: Main function to generate markdown documentation from header files, either individually or combined.
